_readme: Demo travelers for testing the Travelers tab, matching, pins and messaging.
These are NOT real people: the portraits are AI-generated, so no real
person's likeness is used. Every bio ends with a visible [demo] marker and
the runbook requires purging them before real users arrive.
photoUrl values are time-limited generation links. They only matter at
seed time: once uploaded the photos live in Supabase Storage. If a link
has expired, ask Claude to regenerate the portraits before re-seeding.

people.name: Maya
people.bio: Coffee first, plans later. Currently chasing good pastries and cheap flights. Always up for a walk with no destination. [demo]
people.replyOpener: Ah yes, glad you said something. I am doing coffee then wandering most mornings, join me whenever.
people.pingMessage: Hey! We are here the same days it looks like. I am doing a pastry and coffee crawl this week, no agenda, come along if you want.

people.name: Dev
people.bio: Six months into a very slow trip around Asia. I will absolutely talk your ear off about street food. Looking for people to explore with. [demo]
people.replyOpener: Yes! I have a running list of street food places and nobody to drag along, so your timing is perfect.
people.pingMessage: Hey, looks like we overlap. I am eating my way through the night markets this week if you want in.

people.name: Freja
people.bio: Hiker, swimmer, terrible at sitting still. If there is a trail nearby I have probably already looked it up. [demo]

pin.venue: Coast walk, meeting at the tram stop

people.replyOpener: Nice, I was hoping someone would say yes. I am walking the coast path this week, easy pace, good swim halfway.
people.pingMessage: Hi! Saw we are around at the same time. I am doing a coast walk with a swim stop, tell me if that is your kind of thing.

people.name: Theo
people.bio: Here for the night markets and the questionable karaoke. I take photos of everything, sorry in advance. [demo]
people.replyOpener: Great, I need someone to keep me from taking 400 photos of the same noodle stall. When are you free?
people.pingMessage: Hey, we seem to be here the same week. Night market and questionable karaoke is the plan, you are very welcome to join.

people.name: Nora
people.bio: Taking a proper break from work for once. Museums in the morning, long dinners at night. Say hi if you like either. [demo]
people.replyOpener: Lovely, I was after some company for dinner. I do museums in the morning and long dinners at night, pick either.
people.pingMessage: Hi there, looks like our dates line up. I am doing museums then a long dinner this week if you fancy either one.

people.name: Luca
people.bio: First big trip and loving it. Staying in hostels, saying yes to most things. Teach me a card game. [demo]
people.replyOpener: Yes! First big trip and I am saying yes to everything, so tell me what you are doing and I am in.
people.pingMessage: Hey! We are in town at the same time. I am staying at a hostel with a decent rooftop, come hang out if you are free.
